capitalsolutionsgroup-capitalsolutionsgr.description: SECURITY CLEARANCE: TS/SCI with both Polygraphs is required POSITION: Senior Network Engineer REQUISITION: KEY-NE3-03.080626) LOCATION: Ft. Meade, Maryland JOB DESCRIPTION: Provides Network support that requires system level design, architecture or enterprise security and security boundaries, datacenter virtualization, CAN/MAN/LAN infrastructure packet capture software, TCP/IP protocol stack, routing/switching protocols, stateful firewalls, and L3/L4 access controls. • (U) Cisco IOS, CatOS, NxOS, filter and access control, Ciscoworks, TACACS+, ASA, FWSM, HP Openview, Cisco routers, Cisco Switches, F5/Cisco load balancers, Infiniband, Juniper, FiberChannel (FC) SAN, and VPN (IPSEC) • (U) Physical installation and configuration and troubleshooting of network routers, switches, load balancers and security devices. • (U) Strong knowledge of TCP/IP protocol stack and routing and switching protocols. • (U) Strong working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols. • (U) Strong working knowledge of stateful firewalls, and L3 access controls. • (U) Working knowledge of Atlassian Tool Suite. • (U) Able to support on-call requirements. • (U) Able to work in live call environment and utilize remedy and/or other ticketing system to track tasking. • (U) Virtualization products; VMWare and Solaris containers. jobgether-jobgether:lever:25ce6343-ed5a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a HRIS Solutions Developer - Boomi / UKG based in Brazil. This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced HRIS and integration professional to support and optimize enterprise workforce technology within a healthcare environment. You’ll serve as a subject matter expert across UKG Pro Workforce Management and Boomi integration solutions. The role combines hands-on configuration, integration development, troubleshooting, system maintenance, and continuous optimization. You’ll work across HRIS, IT, operational, and vendor teams to deliver reliable solutions and meaningful system enhancements. Your work will help ensure accurate workforce data, dependable integrations, secure system operations, and efficient HR processes. The position offers significant ownership across the HRIS technology ecosystem, including releases, testing, migrations, and change management. It’s well suited to a technically strong professional who enjoys solving complex integration challenges and improving enterprise systems. Configure and maintain UKG Pro Workforce Management (Dimensions), including timekeeping, pay rules, time-off policies, scheduling, analytics, Data Hub, and productivity functionality. Design, develop, test, troubleshoot, and maintain Boomi integrations connecting UKG with other enterprise applications. Build and support APIs, inbound and outbound interfaces, data mappings, transformations, and cloud-based connectors. Manage UKG releases, system updates, security configurations, testing activities, and production migrations. Monitor integration performance, investigate errors, and resolve technical issues to maintain system reliability and data integrity. Partner with HRIS, IT, operational teams, and external vendors to deliver system enhancements, integrations, and technology projects. Maintain accurate technical documentation covering configurations, integrations, processes, and system changes. Follow established change management and Change Advisory Board (CAB) processes to ensure controlled and reliable deployments. Identify opportunities to improve HRIS functionality, integration performance, data quality, and overall system efficiency. Provide technical expertise and guidance on UKG, Boomi, and broader enterprise HRIS integration architecture. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience configuring and supporting UKG Pro Workforce Management (Dimensions) . 5+ years of experience developing and supporting Boomi integrations in an enterprise environment. Strong knowledge of XML, JSON, REST APIs, SOAP, cloud platforms, data transformations, and enterprise integration patterns. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system and integration issues. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across HRIS, IT, business, operational, and vendor teams. Strong project management and organizational abilities, including the capacity to manage multiple priorities and deliver system changes effectively. Experience within the healthcare industry is preferred. UKG and/or Boomi certifications are preferred. Experience with Python, Workday Studio, or SQL is a plus. Strong understanding of enterprise HRIS and ERP ecosystems and their integration requirements. PMP certification is a plus. Benefits Salary range of $120,000 - $140,000 , based on qualifications and experience. Full-time direct-hire opportunity. Remote work arrangement. Opportunity to work with enterprise HRIS and integration technologies in a healthcare environment. Exposure to UKG Pro Workforce Management, Boomi, APIs, cloud integrations, and enterprise systems. jobgether-jobgether:lever:507c6cd0-0525-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Research & Insights Specialist (Contingent) based in the United States. As a Digital Research & Insights Specialist, you’ll help transform user research and survey data into actionable digital experiences and content improvements. You’ll play a hands-on role in designing and administering Qualtrics surveys, analyzing findings, and developing clear insights for clients and internal teams. The position combines digital research, UX, content strategy, project coordination, and client service in a collaborative environment. You’ll contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from research and reporting through implementation, quality review, and client communication. Your work will help identify opportunities to improve digital products and services while supporting meaningful outcomes for underserved populations. This is a remote, full-time opportunity offering exposure to multidisciplinary projects and public-sector clients. The position is contingent upon a final contract award and funding confirmation. Design, configure, distribute, and manage surveys in Qualtrics, including survey logic, reporting, and data outputs. Analyze and synthesize survey and user research findings, translating insights into actionable UX, accessibility, content, and digital improvement recommendations. Produce and format Qualtrics reports, dashboards, correspondence, presentations, and other client-facing deliverables. Collaborate with digital, research, and multidisciplinary teams to translate findings into practical website and product enhancements. Support additional research and feedback activities, including analytics platforms, usability testing, and other user research tools. Manage project activities, timelines, quality reviews, and deliverables while maintaining strong attention to detail. Communicate with clients and external partners to coordinate strategies, implement recommendations, and maintain productive relationships. Participate in meetings, document actionable decisions, coordinate scheduling and logistics, and proactively address project challenges. Support new business development through research, proposal preparation, and other activities that contribute to organizational growth. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in communications, public health, or a related discipline. 1–3 years of experience in digital-focused roles, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience configuring and administering Qualtrics. Familiarity with UX principles, accessibility concepts, digital research, or user feedback methodologies. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce polished materials for internal and external audiences. Excellent interpersonal and project coordination skills, including the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams and with clients. Highly organized, proactive, adaptable, and action-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Strong analytical abilities and attention to detail, combined with a commitment to quality and customer service. Ability to work effectively in a remote environment with reliable internet, a dedicated workspace, and availability during core hours aligned with Eastern Time. Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship, with work performed within the continental U.S. unless otherwise required by contract. Government contracting experience is a plus. Travel is expected to be less than 10%. Benefits: Annual salary range of $57,400–$67,803.75 , with final compensation based on skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors. Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Generous paid time off, including 8 company-observed holidays and 3 floating holidays . launchtn-pilot-3-208c6413-9fd2-4901-97c9.description: The Role Pilot is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Takeoff team. The Takeoff team owns core accounting systems behind Pilot's bookkeeping: how transactions get categorized, how revenue from platforms like Stripe and Shopify gets recognized over the right periods, and how it all ties back to accurate financials. What we ship shows up directly in our customers' books. As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you'll own projects end to end, from design through rollout. You'll work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and accounting experts to ship changes that are safe, well-tested, and easy to reason about. Pilot's backend is written in fully typed Python, and our frontend stack includes JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue.js. We use Terraform to manage infrastructure, deploy containerized services on AWS, and rely on Postgres and modern observability tooling in production. Key Responsibilities Build, test, and deploy software in a continuous manner (we deploy daily or more often) Work with PMs and Product Designers, and participate in product and design reviews Create and contribute to technical specs and testing/rollout plans Write clear technical designs, contribute thoughtful code reviews, and maintain high engineering standards Work with internal customers and stakeholders to ensure we're solving the right problems Mentor and sponsor your teammates to help them grow Investigate production issues, improve system reliability, and support services as needed About You Even if you don't have experience with every part of our stack, we'd still love to talk. We're looking for someone who has: 5+ years of experience as a software engineer Experience with Python or Vue (or other Javascript frameworks) in production Strong coding fundamentals and the ability to write clean, maintainable, well-tested code Good product and systems judgment, especially in ambiguous or evolving problem spaces Strong communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally Experience working effectively on a remote team, including strong async and written communication habits Demonstrated ability to mentor and teach others This position is only available for remote employment in the United States in the following states: CA, GA, NY, NC, TN, TX, and WA Additionally, we're interested in engineers with specialties or backgrounds in accounting as well as fintech and related fields. Nice to Have Experience with Vue in production Experience with accounting systems, double-entry bookkeeping, or revenue recognition Familiarity with agentic or AI-assisted systems in production environments Experience integrating with third-party APIs and external systems (e.g. payment processors) About Pilot Pilot launched in 2017 to bring the back office into the modern era. Pilot provides small businesses with dedicated finance experts - which Pilot hires as full-time, U.S.-based employees - who learn the ins-and-outs of their business. Pilot integrates directly with the billing, banking, expense, and payroll systems customers already use. With a special blend of custom software and expert bookkeepers, Pilot delivers accurate, consistent bookkeeping and financial management and tax services that give entrepreneurs the freedom to focus on their business. Pilot has over 3,000 customers and has raised over $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock. Our investors also include a long list of world-class entrepreneurs, including Patrick and John Collison, Drew Houston, and Diane Greene. Our most recent funding round doubled our valuation to $1.2 billion – Meet Fintech’s Newest Unicorn . Why Pilot?
